item.title: Second Win11 emergency out of band update to address disastrous Patch Tuesday
item.description:
"This cumulative update includes all protections and improvements from the January 2026 Windows security update released January 13, 2026, as well as from the OOB update released on January 17, 2026 (which introduced fixes for two known issues: remote desktop connections and hibernation failures). This same fix is being rolled out to various other versions and editions of Windows too, including Windows 11 version 23H2, Windows Server editions, and more. This is the second emergency out of band update that Microsoft has pushed out for Windows 11 users in a week.

item.title: Alex Honnold completes Taipei 101 skyscraper climb without ropes or safety net
item.description:
• Bold attempt: American rock climber Alex Honnold summited the Taipei 101 skyscraper — with no ropes or safety net — in an event broadcast live. Read more Link Copied. Read more Link Copied.

Top 4 Comments:

mvdtnz:

Very impressive feat, no doubt about it. But the commentary on the Netflix broadcast ruined the spectator experience completely. It was utterly unbearable.

botacode:

We had the privilege to watch at first from the SE corner of the building and later as he climbed by the the observation deck on the 89th floor. Hair raising stuff I'll never forget.

One of the most incredible feats of strength and daring I've ever witnessed. The only thing at all comparable was watching Baumgartner freefall back to earth from the edge of space. Unbelievable!
